2609.30484.title: Do LLMs Understand Context? A Knowledge Graph-Based Evaluation Framework
2609.30484.paper_summary: While large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable linguistic capabilities, a profound question lingers at their core: do these models truly comprehend context or simply excel at pattern matching on an unprecedented scale? Contextual understanding in LLMs refers to the ability to correctly extract relevant information from a given context, integrate it into a coherent internal representation, and reason over it to produce factually consistent and contextually grounded responses. However, traditional methods such as BiLingual Evaluation Understudy (BLEU) and perplexity simply measure surface-level performance. This reveals a critical gap in question answering (QA), where responses must be contextually grounded rather than simply being memorized associations. To fill this void, we propose a novel knowledge graph (KG) based evaluation framework for LLM contextual understanding in QA. Central to this is Semantic Structural Similarity for KGs (S3KG), a hybrid similarity measure combining structural and semantic signals into a single score. In addition, a diagnostic analysis framework is developed to identify and categorize reasoning errors at the triplet level, enabling fine-grained analysis of model failures. Together, across nine benchmarks, S3KG achieves F1 gains of up to $+7.6$ points over the strongest baseline and AUROC up to $0.973$.
2609.30484.paper_summary_zh: 雖然大型語言模型（LLMs）已經達到了顯著的語言能力，但在其核心仍然存在一個深刻的問題：這些模型是否真的理解上下文，還是僅僅在前所未有的規模上擅長模式匹配？ LLMs 中的上下文理解是指從給定的上下文中正確提取相關信息、將其整合成一致的內部表徵，並在此基礎上進行推理以產生事實上連貫且上下文相關的回應的能力。然而，傳統方法如雙語評估基準（BLEU）和困惑度僅僅測量表面層的表現。這揭示了在問題回答（QA）中存在一個關鍵的缺口，其中回應必須是基於上下文的，而不僅僅是被記憶的聯想。為了填補這一空白，我們提出了一個新穎的知識圖譜（KG）基於評估框架，用於 LLM 在 QA 中的上下文理解。這一框架的核心是知識圖譜的語義結構相似性（S3KG），這是一種將結構和語義信號結合成單一分數的混合相似性度量。此外，還開發了一個診斷分析框架，以識別和分類三元組層面的推理錯誤，使得模型失敗的分析更加細緻。綜合九個基準，S3KG 在最強基線之上實現了高達 $+7.6$ 點的 F1 增益，AUROC 高達 $0.973$。
